text:
luc: Quick new-hire question — I'm prepping a 30min customer demo and using a hosted API key from my company laptop behind the corporate proxy. I'm getting sporadic 429s and occasional truncated streaming responses. Who's the fastest contact to get a small hosted quota bump or a sandbox key for the demo? Also, anything IT needs to whitelist on the proxy?
onboard-bot: Welcome to Redwood, Luc! :tada: For demo bumps DM dev-support or post here with the demo window. See the onboarding checklist in the handbook link: https://redwood.dev/onboarding
dev-support: Hi @luc  we usually give a 24-72h hosted bump for internal demos. If you need same-day, say the demo time, expected QPS, and model (e.g., rwd-1-medium). Sandbox keys are faster to provision and have a separate quota if you want zero risk to prod usage.
luc: Demo is tomorrow 2pm-3pm PST, low traffic (peak ~5 req/s). Using rwd-1-medium for chat streaming.
net-admin: Two common issues with corporate proxies: 1) TLS termination / connection pooling can break streaming chunking, resulting in partial responses. 2) IP buckets: if proxy NATs many users to the same egress IP you may hit an IP-level rate cap. Ask IT to allow outbound to api.redwood.ai and to exempt chunked streaming endpoints from buffering. We publish our egress CIDR in the infra docs.
sam: To help debug paste the exact curl and the response headers (redact the key). Look for `x-rate-limit-remaining`, `x-rate-limit-reset`, and `x-request-id`. If the header `retry-after` is missing that's okay but `x-request-id` lets us trace the gateway logs. Example safe curl to paste:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"model":"rwd-1-medium","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' -v
```
luc: here's sanitized response headers from a failing run: 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: req_24b8fd
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
content-type: application/json
Body: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"quota exceeded"}
Also saw some curl errors: `Recv failure: Connection reset by peer` during streaming attempts.
security: Reminder: do not post actual API keys in channels. Store keys in Vault/Secrets Manager and reference them by path when needed. Hosted API tokens are not interactive-MFA protected; auth is via bearer token. For demos, sandbox keys or ephemeral Vault-issued creds are recommended.
net-admin: If you get connection resets only on VPN/proxy, try tethering to a phone hotspot to verify. If it works off VPN but fails on VPN, we need IT to check MTU, connection timeouts, and whether the proxy buffers Transfer-Encoding. If it fails off-VPN too, it's likely a quota issue.
dev-support: For a quick unblock I can: 1) issue a 48h sandbox key (separate quota) immediately, or 2) request a hosted bump — reply which you prefer. If you want a hosted bump we'll need the demo window and expected token/embedding units.
luc: Sandbox key please, easiest for now. I'll test on hotspot and DM you the demo window. Thanks!
ops-bot: Please redact keys in logs. If you hit another 429, paste `x-request-id` and we can follow the request path.
dev-support: Sending sandbox key via DM now. Good luck on the demo! :rocket:
